name: Restoration — nucleation planting design (critical cluster size n* + go/no-go)
summary: Gives the smallest planted cluster that the nucleation model says will grow rather than dissolve (n* = (2aσ/(3Δμ))³), the barrier height, and a go/no-go for a planned cluster size.

inputs.name: sigma
inputs.help: Edge cost σ — how strongly the cluster boundary is penalised (hostile edges, competition, browse). Must be positive; justify it for the site.

inputs.name: delta_mu
inputs.help: Site suitability Δμ — per-tree driving force favouring establishment over loss. Must be positive.

inputs.name: shape_factor
inputs.help: Shape factor a of the cluster boundary (default 1).

inputs.name: cluster_size
inputs.help: Planned cluster size. If given, the result says GO when it reaches n*, NO_GO when it does not.

hypotheses.statement: The edge cost σ is positive.
The site suitability Δμ is positive.
The shape factor a is positive when supplied.

scope: Deterministic theorem-backed computation; empirical input validity is external.
boundary: Model outputs do not establish field suitability, seed availability, land rights, permits, or ecological success. The result is conditional on the supplied inputs; it does not establish empirical validity, Viridis review, certification, a credit, or a registry determination.
